$description:
I-08B3.1-F2 — THE DARK APPEARANCE'S MEANING-LIGHT TECHNIQUE, NAMED FOR THE FIRST TIME.

THIS FILE MOVES NO DARK VALUE AND CONTAINS NO COLOUR. It adds ONE name that did not exist, whose value is a description of what the dark appearance has always done, and it exists for a reason §28 of the brief states directly: 'Do not hard-wire Product logic to if dark -> X else -> Y'.

Until there was a second appearance, the meaning-light technique never had to be named — there was only one, so it lived in the renderer as the renderer's only behaviour. A second appearance needs a different one, and the moment two exist, the choice between them is a Product fact that belongs in the token tree where it can be resolved, inspected and checked. A renderer that reads `technique` from the resolved tree has ONE appearance decision; a renderer that tests `if (appearance === 'light')` has as many as it has call sites and no way to check any of them.

So the dark value is 'additive-over-ground': composite the Light's stop over whatever is beneath it at the falloff's intensity. That is I-08B3.1-D2R's behaviour, unchanged, now written down.

CHECK D-01 COMPARES THE INHERITED NAMES. It asserts that resolving with no options returns exactly the tree I-08B3.1-F1 returns for every name F1 has. This file adds a name F1 does not have and moves none that it does, and the check is written to say so rather than to be silent about it.

technique.$description:
THE DARK APPEARANCE'S MEANING-LIGHT TECHNIQUE. The Light's stop is composited over the ground at the falloff's intensity, so an illuminated region moves from the near-black World toward a near-white warm core. It works in dark because the World occupies almost none of the luminance range and a meaning event can borrow all of it: measured at the event peak it reaches dEok 0.6925 from the unilluminated ground, and averaged over the source's disc, dEok 0.3257.

The same technique on the light World reaches dEok 0.0395 at its own best configuration. That measurement is the whole of §8 of the F2 brief, and it is why this token has a second value in the other appearance rather than one value everywhere.

THE TWO FIGURES IN THIS SENTENCE WERE WRONG UNTIL I-08B3.1-F2R. They read 0.531 and 0.035 — neither of which is any quantity this package measures, at any intensity, on either ground. They were drafted before the search ran and no check covered them, because tools/f2-consistency.mjs guarded hexes, oklch triples and n-of-n counts and not free-standing dEok figures. Claim C7 now does.

com.qandeel.freeze.why: WHICH TECHNIQUE an appearance uses is a rendering strategy, chosen by measurement against the Product contract LIGHT IS MEANING and re-openable by a better one. The CONTRACT is that a meaning event is perceivable AS AN EVENT, settles to nothing, stays separable from the identity material and from reading, and survives having its colour removed. This name says how those are currently achieved in dark; it is not itself a law.
